summary: Page 1 prints fine, but the printed Schedule 1 table drops every Sales Value, Volume of Removals and Basic Excise Tax Due cell for all 12 rows - the whole point of the form - while the grand total still prints; item 10 prints the literal text 'PSIC.' instead of the value.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 rows XB010-XB100 plus both Others rows, columns Sales Value / Volume of Removals / Basic Excise Tax Due
defects.what: Every money cell is blank on the print even though the on-screen cards show the values and per-row tax due, and GRAND TOTAL EXCISE TAX DUE prints 307,785,184.86. Verified by hand three ways: the print-preview window, the app's own Save-as-PDF output, and the generated sheet.html - all identical, all blank. A return printed like this is unusable: it shows a 307.8M total with no supporting rows.

The PSIC cell prints the literal characters 'P S I C .' instead of the entered value 10750 (the string '10750' appears nowhere in the sheet for this field; validation also kept flagging the filled field as invalid). Looks like a placeholder rendered where the value should be.

defects.where: Page 1, item 9 Main Line of Business
defects.what: LOB prints '10750 - BEVERAGE M' and stops mid-word; the comb clips the rest of 'MANUFACTURING'. The official box is a plain free-text comb wide enough for the full line.
City prints 'CITY OF MAKAT' - clipped mid-word at the cell edge (official City cell is a free-text comb). Region/Province do spell out names correctly ('NCR', 'NCR SECOND DISTRI').

The 'Applicable Tax Rate' field can be entered by hand in the row editor but the agent fill API refuses it ('it is written through'), so a script cannot fill a required column; validation then reports 'rate equals zero' for every Others row.

The screen lists 12 Others rows while the paper prints only 2 write-in rows; rows 3-12 (and payload rows 13-15, which the list does not even show) silently never reach the print - same missing-overflow family as 2200M/2200P.

After saving through the draft API the header kept showing 'Unsaved changes' and the Print preview button did nothing on three clicks; only dismissing and reopening the saved draft produced a working preview. State-sync hiccup worth noting alongside the other forms.
No fillable fields exist for items 27-30 (Cash/Bank Debit Memo, Check, Tax Debit Memo, Others) - same unfillable-by-design family as 2200C/2200M/2200P.

entered_by_hand: Opened Others row 1 editor and typed Applicable Tax Rate 12.00 and Sales Value 4,555,666.77; also hand-checked the print preview and the saved app PDF to confirm the blank schedule (S1) - checked by hand once more as required, defect stands.
open_questions: PSIC '10750' validates as filled on screen but still fails the 'enter a valid PSIC' rule and prints as the literal text 'PSIC.' - is the field bound to a different key than txtPSIC?
